name: Gondola
summary: Marketplace for Venice AI inference: holders of Venice DIEM deposit an inference key and set a price, and buyers call frontier models through one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint paid in USDC (also per call over x402); in beta.

key_number.unit: calls in 30 days (CDP Bazaar quality data)

disclosure: Source: listed on YourAITools (youraitools.co, CC BY 4.0), verified by Commonworld unpaid 402 probe 2026-10-23 (20:24-20:59 UTC). No payment, deal or contact with Gondola or YourAITools is involved.

claims.statement: https://gondola-ai.com is the official site: it is the address YourAITools lists for Gondola and the site answers there (page title "Gondola | Frontier models at market price. Idle DIEM, earning USDC.").
claims.quote: Gondola | Frontier models at market price. Idle DIEM, earning USDC.

claims.statement: The site serves real content without sign-in (HTTP 200). It also publishes an llms.txt for agents.
claims.quote: Frontier models at market price on one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint, paid in USDC. Gondola never stores prompts; idle Venice DIEM earns USDC.

claims.statement: Operator's own description: Gondola is a DIEM yield marketplace built on Venice AI.
claims.quote: Gondola is a DIEM yield marketplace built on Venice AI.

claims.statement: Operated by "the Gondola project", per the terms of service (no company named).
claims.quote: Gondola is operated by the Gondola project

claims.statement: Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid POST to https://api.gondola-ai.com/v1/chat/completions answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Base; asset USDC; price 0.01 USDC; payTo Base 0x98886846918c7deBe86E1D74E249DCDd64a9D367). YourAITools lists the price as $0.01–$0.011134. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works.
methods: unpaid POST https://api.gondola-ai.com/v1/chat/completions (HTTP 402, header:payment-required; no payment header sent)

claims.statement: Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (the CDP facilitator's discovery index) lists 3 resource(s) on this vendor's domain for the payTo address(es) we observed, with 4,676 calls in the last 30 days as reported by CDP (largest single resource: 11 unique payers; payers cannot be de-duplicated across resources). These are the facilitator's counts, not an Atlas observation of settlements.
